阅读摘要 Abstract

ENGLISH

Fine-tuning can degrade capabilities that a model acquired before adaptation, but it is usually unclear before training which capabilities will be affected. We study this problem in the model's local tangent space and show that forgetting has a structured geometry there. Under gradient flow, the change in old-task outputs admits an exact decomposition: the new-task loss gradient is transported into the old-task function space through the cross-task tangent kernel $K_{AB}$. This identity separates the forcing induced by the incoming task from the geometry through which it affects existing outputs. In small-output regimes, the resulting forgetting drift is strongly anisotropic and concentrates along leading eigendirections of the old-task kernel $K_{AA}$. This structure suggests a pre-adaptation diagnostic: evaluate the tangent geometry once, before any parameter update, and use it to rank which outputs or capabilities are most likely to move. We test this prediction across vision models and four language-model families. For LoRA fine-tuning of language models, the resulting unnormalised cross-task gradient score ranks held-out capability changes before training, including on three model families not used during development. In contrast, cosine-normalised gradient similarity is negatively correlated with the same realised changes across all tested configurations, indicating that the gradient magnitude removed by normalization contains information relevant to interference. The tangent-space formulation also predicts an optimizer dependence: incorporating the AdamW preconditioner improves the one-step prediction under AdamW but not under SGD, as confirmed by permutation controls. For frozen representations, we further derive a Gauss--Newton correction for cross-entropy. The curvature-aware operator predicts realised output drift better than a curvature-free predictor even when the latter is given an oracle scalar ridge parameter. When representations are allowed to change, the tangent kernel rotates and the quality of a pre-adaptation predictor degrades with training, giving it a measurable validity horizon. Finally, constraining the vulnerable eigenspace identified by the tangent geometry reduces forgetting in vision models and cross-entropy degradation in language models. Our results characterize forgetting as a structured, locally predictable phenomenon in function space. The proposed diagnostic predicts relative vulnerability rather than forgetting magnitude, and is most reliable over short adaptations for which the local tangent geometry remains informative.

人们普遍认为视频基础模型能够习得以对象为中心的结构，但这种结构是否被因果性地使用，以及当对象不再可见时能否保留下来，尚未经过检验。解码无法揭示这两点：线性读出能够从冻结特征中恢复对象身份，但经过训练、用于报告隐藏对象的探针反而会检出遮挡物。我们在模型自身的预测机制中测量对象绑定：从冻结预测器的上下文中删除对象 A 的早期词元，然后读取其未来预测中每个对象对应的性能下降。泄漏率 L 将这一结果与同一流程中测得的端点作比较；每段视频只需进行 K+1 次前向传播，且无需拟合任何参数。在一个预测式视频基础模型（V-JEPA2）和一个扩散模型（CogVideoX）中，对象都得到了强绑定；而且在 V-JEPA2 中，这种绑定是习得的：L = 0.23–0.43，相比之下，未训练模型为 1.00，标签打乱模型为 1.16。这一结果在距离和外观匹配的控制条件下仍成立，并能泛化到真实视频。这些模型却都没有对象恒存性。在遮挡情况下，填补对比度 POperm（隐藏对象减去遮挡物）在涵盖三种训练范式的五个视频基础模型中，于我们的试点场景上从未显著为正；在规模足够大时出现正值的模型（V-JEPA2-H）中，即使对象从未存在，该值也同样为正。扣除读出的自身测量下限后，V-JEPA2 的显著缺陷仍然存在。一个采用逐对象循环状态的以对象为中心的模型达到 +0.264；在双方都覆盖的 62 段视频上，配对差距为 +0.292，其中以对象为中心的模型在 95% 的视频上表现更高。显而易见的修复方法确实有效，但效果并非表面看起来那样：经过两轮遮挡补全微调后，对象恒存性由负转正（三个随机种子下从 −0.024 升至 +0.070），经过八轮微调后，遮挡对象识别率从 0.369 升至 0.522；然而，在对象从未存在的配对反事实条件下，填补增益仍能达到 96–108%，表明这种修复主要是一种对历史信息视而不见的去遮挡先验。对于这类前馈预测器，内部绑定并不意味着具有对象恒存性，而廉价的修复方法也无法赋予它这种能力。
